title: Ijwi ry'Ikiyaya Ricereje
intro: Subira mu gihe ca kera ku bantu b’inkomezi barigeze kuronka igitangaza kizima nk’ikigeragezo. Ubwibone n’ubutagondwa vyatumye bashikirwa n’ingorane. Woba ushobora gukurikirana iyo nkuru maze ukamenya ivyo vyabaye muri iyo mpinduka itangaje?
clues: Narungitswe nk’ikigeragezo c’Imana ku bantu b’inkomezi bazwi kubera inkomezi zabo n’ugutera akagere.
Nari igitangaza kidasanzwe—abantu nkanje ntibari bwigere baboneka muri bo.
Amazi yo kunywa yo mw’iriba narasangira n’abantu banje ku misi ihinduka.
Baragabishijwe yuko ikibi cose cobaye cotuma nhanwa vyihuse.
Abari bafise ubushizi bw’amanga kuruta abandi bose muri bo barirengagije iyo ngabisho maze baranciramwo.
Inyuma y’urupfu rwanje, induru imwe y’inkuba ivuye hejuru yaratikije abantu banje bose.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
